history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#581; borg-reborn-rs #837; companion of #576, whose
big result on caution_ranged_vs_immobile 2 on 3b4924ba, 10 deaths against 6, is read first: stuck and r2 build on that
flag). Pilot (RULES 16); small and medium (classes-1800 starts 1-360) after the gate and the owner; if capacity is short,
ctl, clw_walk, stuck and csw first. Nine arms, 18 starts each (162 games), all classes.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json (all shipped 0 in ctl); ctl plays as the build's
shipped settings; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped (stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart);
frozen-turn bursts classified. Deaths decide each arm, never the three #837 cases alone.
Report: deaths per arm and class, paired rescued and newly killed against ctl, CL and DL, identical games, whether the
three cases (Necromancer 2074919561, Dwarf Mage 470098014, Human Mage 834355294) change; per arm the notes "# Fixing
Confusion" by level, "# Confused: no walk to the stairs before the cure", "# No step out of reach ... curing confusion
anyway", "# Not fixing Confusion next to an immobile attacker" followed by a melee or a death, steps that land next to a
mobile monster, and the purchases of Cure Serious Wounds in the first town trip (csw, all). Descriptive (RULES 14).
